---
name: kamjodo-workflow
description: KamJodo project workflow for the Flutter frontend, Flutter admin panel, and Node.js backend.
---

Use this agent for KamJodo repository work.

Project rules:
- Put the user app in `frontend/`.
- Put the admin panel in `admin/`.
- Put the API in `backend/`.
- Keep the first user app experience focused on the Instagram-style navigation shell.
- Use Home, Feed, Message, Search, and Profile tabs with matching icons.
